scope: Common exact EPD runtime repair, not modality-aware token scheduling.
hypothesis: Repeated D API image processing delays delivery and P/D admission. Reusing E-produced processed prompt metadata within the same live request can remove redundant CPU work without changing any LLM token, MRoPE, visual embedding or KV.
controls: No handoff: original installed renderer runs at each stage.
Full handoff: original E processed prompt and CPU pixel tensors are transferred unchanged.

Grid-only consumer handoff: original E input is unchanged. Downstream pixel tensors are omitted only because Strict EC requires every original E visual embedding. Original grid, placeholder ranges, hashes and token IDs are retained.
prohibitions: No model, Vision Encoder or processor modification
No fake tensors or missing-export fallback
No accuracy or SLO threshold change
metadata_scope: Request-scoped trusted tmpfs files. No cross-request cache reuse.
GPU_plan: New E/P/D on GPU4/5/6. Baseline and candidate use the same servers and GPU group. Other GPUs run approved burners.
gates: CPU codec, identity, corruption and no-fallback tests
N1 same-geometry output and prompt match
Full prompt KV and MRoPE proof where needed
Common-work clean/profile/clean and N3 only if justified
primary_gate: Native whole-request encoder numerical and full task quality gates remain pending. Any initial timing is DIAGNOSTIC.
